text:
Jason: Planning to cut release/1.12 tomorrow at 11:00 PDT. Need a quick sync on backport rules, who will own cherry-pick reviews for infra/runtime, and final cutoff timing.

Anika: Sounds good. Proposal: docs-only PRs -> tag `release/docs` and @Maya can merge after green CI. Any change touching `runtime/`, `serving/`, or `infra/` needs explicit owner review + `backport-needed` label.

Maya: I can handle docs merges this week. Please include a short `Changelog:` line in the PR body so I can capture it. I'll do a sweep at 16:00 PDT and ping missing entries. :mag:

Ravi: For runtime/serving, add a 2-3 line risk summary in the PR description (what could regress). Tag me with `@Ravi` and `needs-backport` label; I'll prioritize those. If it touches batching, KV cache, or kernel selection, mark as high-risk.

Jason: Agreed. To summarize policy: (1) docs-only = @Maya auto-merge, (2) runtime/serving/infra = `backport-needed` + @Ravi review, (3) everything else = normal review flow.

Anika: Cutoff: 09:00 PDT tomorrow for non-critical changes. After cutoff only hotfixes allowed — must include a short RCA and approval from two reviewers, one of whom is a package owner.

release-bot: Heads-up: scheduled to create branch `release/1.12` at 11:00 PDT tomorrow. To delay branch creation comment `@release-bot hold` in this thread.

Maya: I'll maintain a changelog board and tag authors missing descriptions. If anyone wants to prefill entries, add `Changelog:` at top of PR body.

Jason: Backport process: file backport requests on the backport board (https://boards.redwood.ai/backports) with target PR + short rationale. Use this git flow snippet if helpful:
```
# start from latest release branch
git fetch origin
git checkout -b backport/ISSUE-1234-to-release-1.12 origin/release/1.12
git cherry-pick -x <commit-sha>
# resolve conflicts, run tests, push
git push origin backport/ISSUE-1234-to-release-1.12
# open PR against release/1.12 and include link to original PR
```

Ravi: Note: do NOT rebase or force-push the original feature branch after backporting. Keeps audit trail clear. I'll be online 10:30-12:30 PDT to review urgent cherry-picks; ping me with `@Ravi backport` in the PR.

Anika: Also: version bump commit should use conventional message so changelog tooling picks it up, e.g. `chore(release): v1.12.0` (no extra text).

Jason: For emergencies post-cutoff, we have rollback playbook: cut a hotfix branch from `main`, shrink scope to minimal fix, ensure two approvals (owner + SRE), and run the rollback test suite. If rollback is required, follow the incident runbook and notify #incidents.

Maya: Quick ask — if you're backporting a docs-only fix, mention `docs-backport` in the PR title so I can merge quickly.

Ravi: Small ops note: prefer backport PR titles like `backport: <short-desc> (#original)` so they appear cleanly in changelog automation.

Anika: I'll update the release checklist with these items and attach the backport board link. Will also add the exact labels and owner map.

Jason: Thanks all. Tagging owners here: @Maya @Ravi. If anyone needs help with the cherry-pick git commands ping me and I can pair. :rocket:
